{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Count total patients
total_patients = len(df)

# Count patients with valid biomarker_baseline (not -999.0)
valid_patients = len(df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0])

# Compute mean on valid values
mean_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required values
print(f'total_patients: {total_patients}')
print(f'valid_patients: {valid_patients}')
print(f'mean_baseline: {mean_baseline}')"}
